## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (87%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Tier 2 priority: the 90% conformal set cannot exclude Invasive carcinoma (13% risk) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 87%, Invasive 13% | Favors InSitu; Invasive remains possible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (alpha 10%) | Unseparated at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 88th percentile [F6] | Typical input; 12/12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models match each other |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu (40%), 3/5 Invasive [F5] | Split with Invasive neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Below-typical TILs (+0.51 contribution toward invasive) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (0/20 spot check); +0.34 toward invasive [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable weak score (0/20 spot check); -0.22 from invasive [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-1.49 SD; -0.15 contribution); separates Invasive neighbor · Validated
- **Tumor nuclei** (regions 2, 4, 10) · context · 2836/mm² density (97th percentile) [F8], 66% fraction [F7], 43 µm² [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops P(Invasive) beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 2 (84% risk) or 4 (39% risk) contain invasion, matching 3/5 Invasive neighbors.
- Region 10 lacks myoepithelium on drafted p63/calponin stains where invasion scores 1.08 and duct confinement -1.80.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 4**: Inspect highest-risk areas (84%, 39% risk) with dense small tumor nuclei for stromal invasion.
2. **Region 10**: Check myoepithelium where invasion score peaks (1.08); review drafted p63/calponin and ER stain orders.
3. **Regions 5, 8**: Verify duct-confined atypia (region 5, Weak) and sparse TILs (region 8, Weak).
